interface.title: Plant Species Occurrence Dashboard (speciesmap)
interface.field: Biodiversity informatics / plant biogeography (Brazilian Atlantic Forest occurrence records from SpeciesLink)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and scoping data after quality control, and exporting a subset for downstream analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Filter quality-controlled herbarium occurrence records by species, family, state, country and year, see them on a point, cluster or density map with KPI and bar-chart summaries, and export the filtered table as CSV.

data.note: The bundled example dataset loaded automatically: 61,144 records, 359 distinct scientific names, 95.4% georeferenced (screens/003.webp). It holds many families, not only orchids. Orchidaceae is 5,894 records and 27 names (screens/008.webp). Names and families are not normalized: there are 'cf.'/'aff.' variants, misspellings such as 'Orchidadeceae', and a country value 'Desconhecido' (screens/006.webp, screens/050.webp). The exported CSV includes the QC columns COUNTRY_NORM, STATE_FULL and COORD_VALID. Per the app's README and code (streamlit_app.py:118-125), 'Georeferenced %' is the share of records with COORD_VALID==True, and the map plots only those records, while the KPI record count, bar charts, table and CSV keep every record, including quarantined coordinates. The live SpeciesLink fetch and QC pipeline are not available in this setup.

features.name: Faceted multiselect filters with live summary metrics
features.general: Narrow a record set by several categorical facets plus a numeric range, and see headline counts and a coordinate-validity percentage update at once
features.specific: Sidebar Species/Family/State/Country multiselects (type to search, 'Select N matches', clear-all) and a two-handle Year slider drive the Records / Species / Georeferenced % metrics; Georeferenced % is the COORD_VALID==True share, and Records counts all rows including quarantined coordinates; undated records are not removed by the Year range
steps: Type part of a name in a facet box and pick one or more matches (or 'Select N matches')
Add values in other facets; the filters combine as AND
Drag or keyboard-step the year range handles
Read the updated record count, distinct-species count and percent of records with valid coordinates
Clear a facet with its x to widen the scope again
serves_tasks: Restrict to a geographic region, picking more than one area
Restrict to a time window, knowing that undated records are not excluded by it
Restrict to particular taxa, including their name variants
Loosen the scope again by clearing filters
Compare record count, species count and the share of records with valid coordinates across subsets

features.name: Switchable occurrence map gated by coordinate validity: points, density heatmap, or clustered markers
features.general: Show only records whose coordinates passed quality control on a web map, with a choice of point-by-category, density surface, or zoomable count clusters, always for the current filtered set, while counts and exports keep every record
features.specific: 'Map engine' radio Plotly/Folium; plots only COORD_VALID==True rows. Plotly gives px.scatter_map coloured by SCIENTIFICNAME or, with 'Density (heatmap)', px.density_map; Folium gives MarkerCluster with species popups. The Folium cluster path worked at 1,741 records but did not render at 5,841 in the replay, so it is unconfirmed at larger subsets
steps: Choose the map engine
On Plotly, optionally tick Density (heatmap)
Pan or zoom to the study area
Hover a point (lat/lon tooltip) or, on Folium with a small subset, click clusters down to a single marker popup
Change filters and watch the map redraw
